messages:
auditor-bot: alert -> public object s3://partner-onboard/terraform.tfstate contains `vault_ciphertext` fields referencing `transit/keys/platform-key`. marking P0.
noah: confirming. looks like partner uploaded TF state with wrapped blobs that point to our transit key.
sophia: Yikes. immediate: make object private, snapshot original, and scrub public copy.
infra-bot: s3 ACL updated -> object made private (change id s3-881). incident INC-2026-0601 created.
noah: snapshot copied to gs://sec-evidence/INC-2026-0601/tfstate.orig.json (kms-wrapped) and public file replaced with sanitized version.
devsec: checklist: 1) revoke any tokens that could call transit/decrypt 2) rotate transit key 3) rewrap stored ciphertexts 4) search artifacts/repos for `vault_ciphertext`.
sophia: checking Vault audit: found decrypt calls for platform-key from accessor t-abb1 and IP 35.201.9.77 in last 48h. capturing entries.
devsec: revoke accessor now: `vault token revoke -accessor t-abb1` then rotate key: `vault write -f transit/keys/platform-key/rotate`.
auditor-bot: token revoked and key rotated. evidence bundle saved (bundle id b-224).
noah: running repo/artifact grep for `vault_ciphertext`. found 2 CI artifacts and one historical state in internal buckets. quarantining and scheduling rewrap.
sophia: plan for consumers: run `vault write transit/rewrap platform-key ciphertext=<old>` to produce new ciphertexts, push to secure bucket, update integrations to fetch from Vault instead of S3.
devsec: policy changes: restrict transit APIs to infra SAs, short-lived partner tokens only, and forbid writing wrapped blobs to public buckets. add pre-commit hook to block `vault_ciphertext` in commits.
oncall: legal and partner POC notified with minimal details: we rotated keys, secured object, and will provide new wrapped blobs via Vault. joint call in 45m.
sophia: follow-ups: one-click rewrap job in Console, longer SIEM retention for Vault audits, and an onboarding doc update. opening tickets.
noah: summary: public object secured, forensic snapshot taken, token revoked, transit key rotated, artifacts quarantined. will run post-incident detection tuning and publish a short postmortem.
